newsitem.title: UK: BFI dives 31 points as Panamax collapse continues.
newsitem.headline: BFI dives 31 points as Panamax collapse continues.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down a sizeable 31 points on Thursday to 1,361 which brokers attributed to collapsing rates for Panamaxes in the North Atlantic and North Pacific.
The key USGulf/Japan route was reported fixed three times at $22.00 no combo for 54,000 heavy grain for early April, down between 50 cents and one dollar from the last reported levels.

Equally weak were grain fixtures from North Pacific to Japan and Taiwan which were reported fixed by Halla for 54,000 heavy grain for end April at $13.25 no combo, and $13.00 by Continental to Taiwan for early May
The Baltic Handy Index was up two to 1,099 largely as a result of slightly firmer rates for craned tonnage from the Continent to the Far East.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was eleven points down to unchanged and turnover was 162 lots.
